macros.name: clearcounterprefix
macros.doc: The command \clearcounterprefix returns the prefix to its empty default.

macros.name: inputcountersfile
macros.doc: The command \inputcountersfile will input the necessary file, if it exists, and report an error if it does not.

macros.name: opencountersfile
macros.doc: The command \opencountersfile creates and opens the write stream to the file ⟨jobname⟩.counters.tex to store the necessary information.

macros.name: promptrandomizectr
macros.doc: \promptrandomizectr[⟨command⟩]{⟨message⟩}{⟨string⟩} writes ⟨message⟩ to the terminal and awaits a response from the user at the prompt.

macros.name: randprovidecounternz
macros.doc: The command \randprovidecounternz is like \randprovidecounter except that the generated value is nonzero.

macros.name: savecounter
macros.doc: \savecounter{⟨counter⟩} writes \providecounter and \setcounter commands to the file ⟨jobname⟩.counters.tex so that they may be inputted as part of a future typesetting.

macros.name: xabsofcoef
macros.doc: The command \xabsofcoef{⟨counter⟩} prints the absolute value of hcounter i except that it suppresses the values of 1 and 0.

macros.name: xarabic
macros.doc: The command \xarabic{⟨counter⟩} is simply a prefix version of the standard display command \arabic.

macros.name: xarabicnz
macros.doc: \xarabicnz{⟨counter⟩} is like \xarabic but suppresses the number zero.

macros.name: xnegofnz
macros.doc: \xnegofnz{⟨counter⟩} is like \xnegof but suppresses the number zero.

macros.name: xnegsignedcoef
macros.doc: The command \xnegsignedcoef{⟨counter⟩} is like \xnegcoef except that positive values are preceded by a plus sign “+”.

macros.name: xnegsignednz
macros.doc: \xnegsignednz{⟨counter⟩} is like \xnegsigned but suppresses the number zero.

macros.name: xnewcounter
macros.doc: The command \xnewcounter{⟨countername⟩} creates a counter with a prefixed name.

macros.name: xsetcounter
macros.doc: The command \xsetcounter{⟨countername⟩}{⟨integer⟩} assigns the specified value to the counter with the prefixed name.

macros.name: xsigned
macros.doc: The command \xsigned{⟨counter⟩} is like \xarabic except that nonnegative values are preceded by a plus sign “+”.

macros.name: xsignedcoef
macros.doc: The command \xsignedcoef{⟨counter⟩} is like \xcoef except that positive values are preceded by a plus sign “+”.

macros.name: xsignednz
macros.doc: \xsignednz{⟨counter⟩} is like \xsigned but suppresses the number zero.

macros.name: xvalue
macros.doc: The command \xvalue is used to determine the values of the counters, so that the stored prefix is applied to the specified counter names before execution.
